_readme: Robinhood Chain (4663) seed pools. Run with: SEED_POOLS=config/robinhood.json ./scripts/seed.sh robinhood [--broadcast]. See ../README.md for the pool schema. Sized to a tiny ~$1 funded deployer balance (2026-07-10): a single v2 pool only (v3 mint is far more gas-hungry) with minimal WETH wrap, leaving headroom for gas.
